life.body.state.query.summary: Read this Life's current authoritative Life projection and live runtime body state with a gateway audit receipt.

life.activity.query.summary: Read the authoritative Life activity ledger for today, yesterday, or a specified date.

system.capabilities.summary: List supported actions, schemas, risk levels, and adapter-only capabilities.

system.health.summary: Inspect workspace, dependencies, ffmpeg availability, and runtime configuration.

learning.ingest.summary: Create a pending learning card from a host-verified explicit user learning request; never compiles, activates, registers, or releases tools.

file.list.summary: List files/directories under a target directory.

file.read.summary: Read text or base64-encoded binary file preview.

file.write.summary: Write text/base64 file with rollback snapshot.

file.append.summary: Append text to a file with rollback snapshot.

file.copy.summary: Copy a file or directory with overwrite protection and rollback snapshot.

file.move.summary: Move a file or directory with rollback snapshot.

file.rename.summary: Rename a file or directory in place with rollback snapshot.

file.delete_to_trash.summary: Move file/directory into workspace trash; never permanent delete.

file.search.summary: Search filenames and/or text content within workspace.

zip.create.summary: Create a zip archive from files/directories.

zip.extract.summary: Safely extract zip archive under destination with zip-slip checks.

code.read.summary: Read source code file with metadata.

code.write.summary: Write source code and optionally run syntax checks.

code.patch_replace.summary: Patch file by replacing literal or regex text with rollback snapshot.

quality.python_syntax.summary: Compile Python files to detect syntax errors.

quality.run_tests.summary: Run a test command inside workspace; requires allow_shell=True.

python.run.summary: Run Python code or a Python script in workspace; requires allow_python=True.

shell.run.summary: Run shell command in workspace; requires allow_shell=True.

docx.create.summary: Create a Word .docx document from structured sections/tables.

pptx.create.summary: Create a PowerPoint .pptx deck from structured slide specs.

sheet.create.summary: Create an .xlsx workbook from structured sheets.

mindmap.create.summary: Create Mermaid mindmap markdown and optional OPML.

pdf.extract_text.summary: Extract text from a PDF via pypdf.

pdf.create_from_text.summary: Create a simple PDF from text via reportlab.

image.add_text.summary: Add simple text overlay to image.

audio.tone.summary: Create a simple WAV tone/beep/music bed placeholder.

audio.concat.summary: Concatenate audio files using ffmpeg concat demuxer.

audio.tts.summary: Text-to-speech through configured TTS backend adapter.

voice.clone_authorized.summary: Only for owned/consented voices; disabled by default and requires explicit external consent gate.

video.cut.summary: Cut a video segment using ffmpeg.

video.slideshow.summary: Create simple slideshow video from images using ffmpeg.

rollback.apply.summary: Restore snapshots for a previous mutating operation.

browser.open.summary: Open or operate browser through Playwright/Selenium/GUI adapter.

browser.search_web.summary: Use host model/web-search tool; this portable package has no bundled web access.
